extension.summary: Spotify for Kodi with consistent art, metadata, and background loading (Kodi Connect style)
extension.description: Unofficial Spotify music plugin for Kodi. Improves on the original Spotify addon with consistent album/artist art in all views (including playlists), correct metadata tags, and background loading so navigation and playback feel smooth. Requires Spotify Premium.
extension.disclaimer: This product uses the SPOTIFY WEB API but is not endorsed, certified or otherwise approved in any way by Spotify. Spotify is the registered trademark of Spotify AB.
extension.news:
v1.0.16 - Tear down all Spotify audio resources (spotty processes, HTTP streams, prebuffer, cache downloads) the instant a non-Spotify player starts, preventing Amlogic audio driver deadlocks when switching from Spotify to a movie (e.g. via PlexKodiConnect).
v1.0.15 - Keep Spotify's real dynamic Daylist title authoritative: generic responses now stay as "daylist" and retry until the personalized title is available, instead of using a forced period fallback. - Resolve older Made For You hub category routes to Spotify's current category id so startup/restored hubs do not 404 on the stale made-for-you slug.
v1.0.14 - Keep Daylist hub rows from falling back to plain "daylist" when Spotify only returns the generic playlist title, using the current Daylist period as a startup-safe fallback.
v1.0.13 - Start speculative prebuffering only after Kodi confirms Spotify playback, and avoid serving silence-only WAV bodies when Spotty fails before real PCM.
v1.0.12 - Speed up Spotify hubs and playlist lists by using short-lived route caches before live refresh, avoiding per-playlist follow checks, and reusing New Releases album pages. - Skip dynamic container refreshes when Kodi cannot confirm the active folder.
v1.0.11 - Prime the full Kodi startup burst with real Spotify PCM so queued playback cannot skip after only one decoded chunk.
v1.0.10 - Refresh cached Daylist rows that still show the generic "daylist" title, and fall back to cached playlist rows when Spotify browsing is temporarily unavailable.
v1.0.9 - Show playlist hub sublabels from their parent grouping, such as Made For You or Featured playlists, instead of Kodi's generic Folder fallback.
v1.0.8 - Show Spotify Daylist's current dynamic title in playlist hubs, with "daylist" as the secondary label where skins support it.
v1.0.7 - Wait for real Spotify PCM before releasing the initial WAV response so CoreELEC PAPlayer does not skip silence-only startup streams.
v1.0.6 - Harden Spotify playback startup on CoreELEC by extending the WAV preroll and preventing non-critical track-start worker floods from breaking playback.
v1.0.5 - Make Liked Songs render from the first saved-track page, then hydrate the rest in the background without manual pagination.
v1.0.4 - Improve browsing performance with hidden dynamic paging, page-local relation checks, bounded optional precache, adaptive prebuffer timing, and quieter default logging.
v1.0.3 - Fix intermittent Music OSD like button disappearance when PAPlayer metadata is late.
v1.0.2 - Fix cold Spotify stream startup skips by adding an immediate silent WAV preroll before live PCM arrives.
v1.0.1 - Primez branch metadata/version bump for repository auto-updates.
v1.0.0 - Fork of plugin.audio.spotify with Kodi Connect–style improvements. - Consistent art: thumb, poster, fanart, and icon set for albums, artists, playlists, and tracks so every list view shows art. - Correct metadata: proper Kodi music info types (year, duration, tracknumber, albumartist, etc.) for reliable tagging. - Background precache: library precache runs in a thread so the main menu appears immediately. - Smoother playlist play: first track starts quickly; remaining tracks are queued in the background.
